aeroplane.name: nose
aeroplane.description: The forward tapered nose forms the sharp leading silhouette of an aeroplane.

aeroplane.name: wings
aeroplane.description: The broad lateral wings extend from the fuselage and define most of the object span.

aeroplane.name: fuselage
aeroplane.description: The long central body links the cockpit, wings, tail, and engines into one structure.

aeroplane.name: tail
aeroplane.description: The rear vertical and horizontal stabilizers create a compact tail assembly.

aeroplane.name: engines
aeroplane.description: Engine pods or intakes appear as rounded mechanical parts attached to wings or fuselage.

bicycle.name: wheels
bicycle.description: Two thin circular wheels dominate the bicycle outline and often contain visible spokes.

bicycle.name: frame
bicycle.description: The angular metal frame connects the wheels, seat, handlebar, and pedals.

bicycle.name: handlebar
bicycle.description: The handlebar is the narrow steering part above the front wheel.

bicycle.name: seat
bicycle.description: The saddle is a small dark support placed above the frame.

bicycle.name: pedal_chain
bicycle.description: The pedal and chain region forms a compact mechanical cluster near the lower center.

bird.name: beak
bird.description: The beak forms a narrow, tapering, sharply defined outer silhouette.

bird.name: wings
bird.description: The wings are layered side structures that may be folded or spread from the body.

bird.name: claws
bird.description: The claws are small pointed foot details at the lower end of the legs.

bird.name: plumage
bird.description: The plumage is the feathered surface texture covering the body, wings, and head.

bird.name: tail
bird.description: The tail feathers form a rear fan or tapered extension of the body.

boat.name: hull
boat.description: The hull is the main floating body with a curved or elongated lower silhouette.

boat.name: bow
boat.description: The bow is the pointed or raised front part cutting through water.

boat.name: stern
boat.description: The stern is the rear structure, often flatter and sometimes containing a motor.

boat.name: deck
boat.description: The deck is the top surface where cabins, seats, or rails appear.

boat.name: mast_cabin
boat.description: A mast, cabin, or upper fixture provides vertical structure above the hull.

bottle.name: neck
bottle.description: The narrow neck rises above the wider body and leads to the opening.

bottle.name: cap
bottle.description: The cap or top rim is a small closure at the highest point.

bottle.name: body
bottle.description: The body is the main cylindrical or contoured volume of the bottle.

bottle.name: shoulder
bottle.description: The shoulder is the sloped transition between body and neck.

bottle.name: base
bottle.description: The base is the flat or rounded bottom support of the bottle.

bus.name: front
bus.description: The front face contains windshield, lights, and a broad vertical vehicle plane.

bus.name: side_body
bus.description: The long rectangular side body forms most of the bus mass.

bus.name: windows
bus.description: Rows of large rectangular windows are repeated along the upper side.

bus.name: doors
bus.description: Passenger doors create vertical panels on the side or front.

bus.name: wheels
bus.description: Large dark wheels appear along the lower edge of the vehicle.

car.name: front_rear
car.description: The front and rear ends contain lights, bumpers, grille, or trunk surfaces.

car.name: body
car.description: The main body is a compact rounded vehicle shell.

car.name: roof
car.description: The roof and cabin top create the upper contour of the vehicle.

car.name: windows
car.description: Windshield and side windows form dark glass regions in the cabin.

car.name: wheels
car.description: Round wheels anchor the lower corners and distinguish the car from background roads.

cat.name: head
cat.description: The head contains the face, ears, eyes, and muzzle and is often highly salient.

cat.name: ears
cat.description: Pointed ears create two triangular structures above the head.

cat.name: torso
cat.description: The torso is the flexible central body covered by fur.

cat.name: legs_paws
cat.description: Legs and paws form slender supports beneath or beside the torso.

cat.name: tail
cat.description: The tail is a long curved extension from the rear body.

chair.name: backrest
chair.description: The backrest is the upright support behind the seating area.

chair.name: seat
chair.description: The seat is the horizontal surface where a person sits.

chair.name: legs
chair.description: The legs are narrow supports descending from the seat to the ground.

chair.name: arms
chair.description: Armrests, when present, form lateral supports beside the seat.

chair.name: frame
chair.description: The frame connects backrest, seat, legs, and arms into a single object.

cow.name: head
cow.description: The head includes muzzle, eyes, ears, and often horns.

cow.name: torso
cow.description: The large barrel-shaped torso forms most of the cow's visible mass.

cow.name: legs
cow.description: Four long legs support the heavy body and create vertical lower structures.

cow.name: tail
cow.description: The tail is a thin rear extension often ending with a tuft.

cow.name: hide_pattern
cow.description: The hide pattern and broad animal surface help distinguish the cow from background.

diningtable.name: tabletop
diningtable.description: The tabletop is the broad horizontal surface defining the table extent.

diningtable.name: edges
diningtable.description: Straight edges and corners outline the tabletop boundary.

diningtable.name: legs
diningtable.description: Table legs are vertical supports beneath the top.

diningtable.name: apron_frame
diningtable.description: The apron or support frame connects the top to the legs.

diningtable.name: surface_items
diningtable.description: Objects on the tabletop may occlude it but still indicate the table region.

dog.name: head
dog.description: The head contains the muzzle, eyes, ears, and nose.

dog.name: ears
dog.description: Ears may be pointed, floppy, or folded and sit on both sides of the head.

dog.name: torso
dog.description: The torso is the central fur-covered body mass.

dog.name: legs_paws
dog.description: Legs and paws support the body and extend below the torso.

dog.name: tail
dog.description: The tail extends from the rear and may be curved, raised, or lowered.

horse.name: head_neck
horse.description: The elongated head and neck form a distinctive forward upper structure.

horse.name: torso
horse.description: The large muscular torso forms the main body mass.

horse.name: legs_hooves
horse.description: Long legs and hooves create four strong vertical supports.

horse.name: mane
horse.description: The mane is a hair ridge along the neck.

horse.name: tail
horse.description: The tail is a long hair-covered extension from the rear.

motorbike.name: wheels
motorbike.description: Two round wheels define the lower front and rear extent.

motorbike.name: handlebar
motorbike.description: The handlebar and fork form the steering structure above the front wheel.

motorbike.name: seat
motorbike.description: The seat is a narrow support above the central frame.

motorbike.name: frame_engine
motorbike.description: The frame and engine create a dense mechanical cluster in the middle.

motorbike.name: body_panels
motorbike.description: Body panels, tank, and fairing shape the visible outer surface.

person.name: head
person.description: The head is the upper round or oval body part containing face and hair.

person.name: torso
person.description: The torso is the central upright body region often covered by clothing.

person.name: arms
person.description: Arms extend from shoulders and may bend or occlude the torso.

person.name: legs
person.description: Legs extend downward from the hips and define the standing or sitting pose.

person.name: hands_feet
person.description: Hands and feet are small extremities at the ends of limbs.

pottedplant.name: pot
pottedplant.description: The pot is the container at the base with a solid geometric silhouette.

pottedplant.name: stem
pottedplant.description: Stems rise from the pot and connect leaves or flowers.

pottedplant.name: leaves
pottedplant.description: Leaves create irregular green shapes around the upper plant.

pottedplant.name: flowers
pottedplant.description: Flowers, when present, add small bright regions among leaves.

pottedplant.name: soil_base
pottedplant.description: The soil or base region sits between pot rim and plant stems.

sheep.name: head
sheep.description: The head includes muzzle, ears, and eyes and may contrast with wool.

sheep.name: wool_body
sheep.description: The wool-covered torso forms a rounded textured mass.

sheep.name: legs
sheep.description: Thin legs extend downward beneath the wool body.

sheep.name: ears
sheep.description: Ears protrude laterally from the head.

sheep.name: tail
sheep.description: A small tail may appear at the rear edge of the wool body.

sofa.name: backrest
sofa.description: The backrest is the large rear cushion or upholstered vertical plane.

sofa.name: seat_cushions
sofa.description: Seat cushions create broad horizontal padded regions.

sofa.name: armrests
sofa.description: Armrests form bulky side structures on one or both ends.

sofa.name: base
sofa.description: The lower base supports the cushions and often sits close to the floor.

sofa.name: upholstery
sofa.description: Continuous upholstery texture links the cushions into one sofa object.

train.name: front_engine
train.description: The front engine or cab forms a leading face with windows and lights.

train.name: carriages
train.description: Repeated carriage bodies extend along the track direction.

train.name: windows
train.description: Rows of windows mark the passenger compartments.

train.name: wheels_tracks
train.description: Wheels and undercarriage align with rails at the bottom.

train.name: roof
train.description: The roofline forms a long upper contour across the train.

tvmonitor.name: screen
tvmonitor.description: The screen is the large flat rectangular display area.

tvmonitor.name: bezel
tvmonitor.description: The bezel is the border framing the screen.

tvmonitor.name: stand
tvmonitor.description: The stand supports the monitor below or behind the display.

tvmonitor.name: base
tvmonitor.description: The base is the flat lower support connected to the stand.

tvmonitor.name: back_panel
tvmonitor.description: The rear panel and casing define the monitor volume when seen from an angle.
